$reason: The reference's `<section>` with `role="none"` written on it, still handed the name. ARIA forbids a name on `none` and `presentation`; the engines settle the conflict by dropping the written role (Chromium 153 and Firefox 157 show a named region, axe adds `presentation-role-conflict`), so the template says one thing and the page another. A rule that read only the tag's own role passes it: the section, named, is a region.
